scope: Managed Sites preview of the V9 source, exercised in the cloud browser

renderer.limitation: These observations do not verify interactive GPU rendering or frame rate. Separate CPU images use the exported Three.js meshes.

observations: The initial route opens Santa María and its first stop.
The local plan exposes all 16 stops; selecting Naves changes both the route and the current heading.
The chronology contains 17 entries with stop links; the last link was exercised and opened the clock stop. All 17 targets are also validated against the visit data.
The source panel presents 24 references with HTTP(S) links; a fact source opens its correct document entry.
The five period categories and the reading toggle retain their visible selected state.
Switching to Teatro Romano retains its 16-stop visit and independent progress.
Switching to Castillo retains its 18-stop visit and independent progress.
Santa María has independent visit progress and state.
The theme selector changes between Atlas oscuro and Lectura clara.
Unavailable 3D controls are correctly disabled when WebGL is disabled.

viewports.result: Desktop panel, current stop, local plan and navigation fit the viewport.
No horizontal panel overflow. All 16 plan markers remain selectable; marker 14 opens the clock stop.
The compact landscape layout keeps the current stop heading visible and preserves 44-pixel touch controls.

fixesConfirmed: The full local plan uses a canvas backing size matching its displayed mobile size, preserving legible labels.
The short landscape panel compacts spacing so the current stop title is visible.
The initial data-load error describes a failed load without promising unavailable fact sheets.
